before_html: After the day, look at what actually happened. If you did the Protector action(s), not feeling better right away is information to learn from. It doesn’t mean failure. Healing is nonlinear, and sometimes standing up for yourself might make you feel worse at first. And you can ask yourself again, “What is this practice supposed to help, and how would I know if it’s helping?” Not doing it is harder to figure out. Fear is the first guess, but maybe you didn’t know how or why. Being worn out can stop you too, and sometimes whoever said they’d help couldn’t make it. Hey, we’ve all been there. 🤗

before_html: Maybe you’d rather that your support person were a lover, as well. Lots of people open a dating app in the middle of the night, hoping someone will make it all stop hurting. 🙈 If that’s you right now, dating can wait while your friends and the steady people around you do their part. That doesn’t mean you have to be completely healed before you date, but when romance should follow when two people really love each other and want to build a life together. It won’t rescue you from the pain or reward you for healing, and it sucks to mess up a beautiful relationship because of unhealed trauma, believe me, I know. I wrote a whole romance guide, mostly due to this.
